query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Retrieve Salesforce CRM report and query data for a business-performance brief, then send Slack notifications with the generated results.
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve report and query data from Salesforce CRM for business performance analysis.

requirement_groups.purpose: Run a Salesforce report synchronously to retrieve performance data
Execute a SOQL query against Salesforce to retrieve data

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if report_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate/confirm the target report using SALESFORCE_LIST_REPORTS (capture report_id).
[Required] [Step]: Execute the report using SALESFORCE_RUN_REPORT (capture instance/status; inspect allData/hasDetailRows and factMap keys to determine where detail rows vs aggregates live).
[Required] [Next Step]: Retrieve finalized output using SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT_INSTANCE (poll/retry until completion/success, then extract rows/aggregates from the correct factMap bucket).

[Optional (if you need stable column labels or a flat table)] [Next Step]: Fetch definition/metadata using SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT (join reportMetadata.detailColumns to reportExtendedMetadata.detailColumnInfo labels; align each row’s dataCells by index; use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH if JSON is too large/truncated to parse locally).

[Fallback (if report access is forbidden or results are too nested/truncated or missing required fields)] [Fallback]: Recreate an equivalent dataset using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (optionally confirm field API names via SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT; paginate until complete, and split complex filters into simpler queries if needed).
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_RUN_REPORT] Inline results can be partial (for example allData=false) or appear truncated/offloaded; don’t infer “no rows” from a preview payload.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_REPORT] Detail rows and aggregates are split across factMap buckets (often with totals markers); parsing the wrong bucket can look empty.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_REPORT] rows[*].dataCells frequently contain objects (label/value/record-like) rather than scalars; naive casting can drop values or raise TypeError.
[SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT_INSTANCE] Polling/parsing before the instance reports success can yield incomplete rows even when a later fetch is complete.

[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Common HTTP 400s include INVALID_FIELD/MALFORMED_QUERY; large extracts often require pagination (commonly ~2000 records per batch) and overly complex OR-style filters may need splitting.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Inspect a report-run payload to decide whether to poll and which factMap buckets to parse.
Flatten detail rows by mapping metadata columns to labels and aligning indices to rows[*].dataCells.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_RUN_REPORT.description: Runs a report synchronously (GET /analytics/reports/{id}?includeDetails=true) and returns the results in one call. This does NOT create an asynchronous report instance — for that, use the async run resource. Results are returned in a nested structure (factMap, reportExtendedMetadata), not a flat record list; an empty factMap/rows is a valid result. Avoid repeated calls when freshness allows.

report_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the report to run.

SALESFORCE_GET_REPORT_INSTANCE.description: Gets the results of a report instance created by running a report. Poll `attributes.status` until it equals 'Success' before parsing results. Response data is nested under `factMap` and `reportExtendedMetadata`; an empty `factMap` or zero rows is a valid successful result, not an error.

report_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the report.

instance_id.description: The report instance ID returned from running a report.

SALESFORCE_LIST_REPORTS.description: Lists reports with basic metadata including name, ID, and URLs. Note: the Analytics REST API (GET /analytics/reports) returns only up to ~200 recently-viewed reports, not the org's entire report catalog.
